findings.title: Test name promises data: URL coverage but only tests javascript: payload
findings.description: The test 'a media block with a javascript:/data: url does NOT become an (icon fallback)' tests only a javascript:alert(1) URL. No test case passes an actual data:image/... or data:text/html payload to previewThumbUrl. The guard itself (HTTP_URL_RE = /^https?:\/\//i) correctly rejects data: URLs because they lack the http(s):// prefix, so the production code is sound. However the test's label implies coverage that is not present — a future maintainer may incorrectly believe data: is exercised.
findings.impact: No security impact — the allowlist regex rejects data: correctly. The gap is in test coverage confidence only.
findings.recommendation: Add a second parameterized assertion inside the same test (or a dedicated case) with mediaUrl: 'data:image/png;base64,abc' to make the test match its declared scope.

summary.v_html_assessment: CLEAN — zero v-html directives in FunnelCanvasNode.vue or FunnelCanvas.client.vue. All user-controlled fields (message text, caption, button labels, note text) are rendered exclusively via {{ }} Vue template interpolation, which HTML-escapes the output. Comments in-code and a dedicated XSS test confirm the convention.
summary.media_src_assessment: SOUND — previewThumbUrl is gated by a strict allowlist regex (HTTP_URL_RE = /^https?:\/\//i). The guard rejects javascript:, data:, file://, and opaque Telegram file_id tokens (no scheme). The validated URL is bound only to ; it is NOT propagated to :href, :style, innerHTML, or any other sink. referrerpolicy='no-referrer' is set on the img element. The ALBUM path (block.items[0].mediaUrl) passes through the same isHttpUrl() gate before being stored in previewThumbUrl.
summary.injection_test_assessment: LOAD-BEARING and correct — the test at line 701 injects '' into text, caption, and callback button label simultaneously. It asserts: (1) no real element present; (2) <img is present (entity-encoded proof); (3) exactly one real with data-test='funnel-canvas-preview-thumb'. This covers the primary stored-XSS vector. The javascript: scheme test at line 730 verifies src-less fallback. The single gap is no explicit data: URL assertion (minor, not a blocker).
summary.url_button_assessment: SAFE — URL buttons (type='url') are rendered as display-only <span> chips. The btn.url field is never read or bound in FunnelCanvasNode.vue; only btn.label is used via truncate() inside {{ }} interpolation. No :href or other URL sink is present.
